beats.say: Minecraft: 400 million copies sold. That is over six times the entire population of the United Kingdom.
It stands as the best-selling video game of all time since launching on 18 November 2011.
New players receive a randomly selected character skin from nine possibilities when they start.
Every full cycle of the in-game time system lasts exactly 20 real-time minutes.
Exploring the world leads you towards an impassable barrier located 30 million blocks away in every direction.
Fans also saw the release of A Minecraft Movie in cinemas back in 2025.
No other title in history has ever reached this massive level of success.
How many hours have you spent building in your favourite world?
